India and ASEAN Agree to Deepen Disaster Management Cooperation

At the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit in Manila, India and ASEAN adopted a joint statement to strengthen cooperation in disaster management and early warning systems. Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the growing partnership between India and ASEAN, advocating for increased cooperation to ensure peace, stability, and prosperity in the Indo-Pacific. He also pitched 'Cooperation, Not Competition' to ASEAN. Separately, Prime Minister Modi reaffirmed the Quad's Indo-Pacific commitment at a summit in Manila, stating the bloc 'is here to deliver'.
